lines.text: He posts silly comments to annoy!

data.define: To post things to upset or tease others.

misuse.text: Don't call someone a 'troll' for disagreeing politely.
misuse.why: It means purposely annoying, not honest.

hook.text: He posts silly comments to annoy!

publish.title: What does "troll" mean?
publish.value: Troll = Tease online to annoy people. Example: "Ignore him, he's just trolling." (casual English).
